scope: Exact-file preflight hardening for the recorded MTR1 current packet and the retained parallel ASPC research packet. This is validation tooling, not a new geological experiment or a claim of organizer acceptance.

implemented: Shared gems.preflight module that independently reports exact-file format checks, strict whole-array range compatibility, pinned template bytes, note length, and hash-bound promotion evidence.
CLI scripts/preflight_submission.py; it writes a JSON receipt and never contacts DrivenData or uploads a file.

The current MTR1 static-site build fails if its exact preflight is absent, stale, does not bind to the run-card identity, does not pass the strict global range diagnostic, or does not report DO_NOT_SUBMIT.
First-screen and executive-summary links expose the current exact preflight receipt.
pass_1_implementation.observed_result: Both zero-outside research TIFFs are float32, one band, on the pinned mirror grid, finite and in [0,1] over the footprint and under a strict whole-array test. Each run card is hash-bound but negative and not authorized, so each automated decision is DO_NOT_SUBMIT.

fixed: A self-consistent custom template cannot yield OK_TO_SUBMIT without an explicit expected template SHA-256.
A malformed, hash-mismatched, renamed, non-promoted, or non-authorized run card cannot yield scientific authorization.
NaN-outside encoding is distinguished from a stricter whole-array [0,1] portal-compatibility diagnostic rather than silently treated as the cause of the reported portal error.
Receipt output omits local absolute paths so it can be published and reproduced in another checkout.
tests: Both negative zero-outside packets may pass format and strict-range checks yet still return DO_NOT_SUBMIT.
The ASPC NaN-outside twin is format-valid but fails the stricter whole-array range diagnostic.
A synthetic unit-only promoted card verifies that every required hash-bound gate is needed for an OK_TO_SUBMIT path.

No score, current leaderboard value, organizer receipt, portal access, or promotion was invented.

next_steps: Do not spend a competition slot on either negative packet. Obtain an assigned lane and reconstruct a current comparable OOF benchmark before a new preregistered hypothesis.
